Evidence: crates/tracedecay-memory-provider-api reuses product/contracts/memory-provider-v1/generated/rust/memory_provider_v1.rs directly and defines validated owned provider/capability IDs, complete TraceDecay-owned coding scope, cooperative cancellation, finite operation control, capability-routed operations, negotiated provider limits, real descriptors, canonical payload/extension wrappers, validated calls, typed terminal replies, HandshakeRequestParts and handshake values, and the object-safe MemoryProvider trait. The crate has no dependencies. Its strict-lint-clean behavioral tests cover generated identifier validation, exact scope, cancellation versus deadline, mandatory and duplicate capabilities, mutation idempotency, operation-capability admission, trait-object handshake/invocation, and deterministic capability ordering without unwrap, expect, panic, todo, unimplemented, or constant-false assertions. Root Cargo.toml and generated Cargo.lock contain only additive path-package wiring tracked in the convergence map, whose counters are derived from the actual immutable-floor diff. Cargo metadata, fmt, strict Clippy, tests, generated-binding drift, patch budget, and metadata dependency audit all pass.
